name: qoder-openai-proxy
description: OpenAI-compatible API proxy for Qoder CLI

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch" "tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --watch" "node --watch dist/server.js"
scripts.test:watch: npm run build && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch" "tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --watch" "vitest"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
